meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你给的结构化文档和意图转成四张卡片：蓝卡列可溯源的事实、绿卡做机制解释、黄卡标风险与不确定性、红卡给下一步行动建议。每张卡片都带来源与生成方式，可追溯。
howto.when: 当你提供解析后的结构化文档并说明查询意图、要做四色分析时触发；也可用脚本按 extract、review、propose 三个阶段运行。

say.text: 用四色卡片分析这份文档，意图是评估方法学风险
黄卡里哪些断言没有来源，帮我挑出来
say.note: 无来源事实会标注「无来源」

say.text: 先跑 extract 阶段，只抽取蓝卡事实

howto.what_en: Installs a four-card analysis: blue cards for source-backed facts, green for explanations, yellow for risks and overclaiming, red for next-step actions. Cards carry sources and generation method, so they stay traceable.
howto.when_en: Use when you supply a parsed structured document plus your intent and want the four-card analysis, or run the script with --stage extract, review, or propose.

say_en.text: Analyze this document with four-color cards; my intent is method risk
say_en.note: Produces blue, green, yellow, red cards

say_en.text: Which yellow-card claims have no source? List them
Run the extract stage only, just the blue facts
